text.p: Transmation Inc said Monday approved a 2 for 1 stock split, to be paid in the form of a 100 percent stock dividend, payable to shareholders of record July 1, 1997 and distributed on July 22, 1997.

After shares are distributed pursuant to this dividend, there will be approximately 5,695,000 shares outstanding, of which approximately 4,100,000 will be represented by shares considered to be in the public float.

"This action was taken by our Board because it believes there is a need to increase the number of shares outstanding to make Transmation shares available to a wider number of investors," said president Robert Klimasewski. "Having additional shares available will make it easier for certain investment professionals and other investors to make investments in Transmation," he continued.
